result.summary: Makes LevelDB point-read and deserialization failures fatal directly inside CDBWrapper, notifying the owner's kernel notifications interface and aborting. Extends fatal failure handling to txindex consistency and block-file read errors during transaction lookups. Eliminates CCoinsViewErrorCatcher by connecting the coins cache directly to CCoinsViewDB, removes HaveCoin from the backing coin view, and marks coin view lookups noexcept.
result.problem: Previously, CDBWrapper::Read() returned false on deserialization failures (masking corruption as missing keys) and threw LevelDB point-read exceptions that callers could catch, allowing corrupted index lookups to fail individual RPC requests while the node continued running with damaged storage. Additionally, chainstate required a dedicated CCoinsViewErrorCatcher view layer solely to intercept read errors.
evidence: PR description: 'A corrupt txindex point read can consequently fail one RPC while the node continues running. #35728 reports other txindex lookup failures as errors that callers can also catch while the node continues running.'

Commit 45ab8a7012: 'When a txindex point read encounters a corrupt LevelDB table, the RPC reports the error and the node continues running. CDBWrapper::Read() throws on a LevelDB failure without notifying the database owner and reports a corrupt value as a missing key.'
result.scope_notes: Touches database wrappers across chainstate, block storage, and all secondary index subsystems (txindex, coinstatsindex, blockfilterindex, txospenderindex). Startup point-read failures will now abort rather than reaching the GUI's database rebuild prompt.
result.changed_since_previous: Expanded scope to make txindex transaction lookup failures (including block-file read errors and consistency mismatches) fatal through BaseIndex fatal error reporting before aborting.
result.card: Makes LevelDB point-read and deserialization failures fatal inside CDBWrapper by logging the path and error, firing kernel fatal error notifications, and aborting. It also makes txindex consistency and block-file read failures fatal, eliminates the CCoinsViewErrorCatcher view layer, restricts HaveCoin to CCoinsViewCache, and marks coin view lookups noexcept. Previously, corrupt index reads or block-file read errors could fail single RPC queries while leaving a damaged node running, or mask corrupt UTXO entries as absent keys.

risk.why: A false-positive fatal error or unexpected exception escaping a noexcept coin-view lookup will immediately crash the node.
